notes: The half-buried flat slab. This is the single most literal thing in the reference: the grass in the foreground of grasslands.jpg is broken by wide, flat, barely-tilted plates of blue-grey rock lying almost level with the ground, catching the key on one face. High `bedding` so nearly every cut is horizontal, low `height` so the form is a plate, and `embed` 0.38 so a third of it is under the turf and the silhouette is an interrupted edge rather than a floating tile.
